notes: Term-request re-check (#12): this was recorded as an ENVO term request on the premise that "ENVO has only plant-associated and animal-associated environment with no shared parent". That premise is false. ENVO:01001000 'environmental system determined by an organism' is that shared parent — the vendored subclass edges show plant-associated (ENVO:01001001), animal-associated (ENVO:01001002) and fungi-associated (ENVO:01001041) environment all asserted under it — and it has been in the slice the whole time. Its definition, 'an environmental system which is determined by a living organism', is exactly what this top-level bin means: an isolate whose habitat is a living host. Grounded EXACT. The claim was made by hand and never machine-rechecked, which is the same staleness the class-level sweeps have a gate for and individually-decided records did not.
